    for _ in range(t):
        l = data[idx]-1; r = data[idx+1]-1; idx += 2
        m = query_min(l, r)
        g = query_gcd(l, r)
        length = r-l+1
        if g % m == 0:
            # count of m in [l,r]
            plist = pos_dict[m]
            left = bisect_left(plist, l)
            right = bisect_right(plist, r)
            cnt = right - left
            out.append(str(length - cnt))
        else:
            out.append(str(length))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
